name: pyrax-web-fuzz
description: Coverage-guided (Jazzer.js) fuzzing of the untrusted-input parsers/verifiers in the PYRAX web portals: SigV4/ListObjectsV2 XML parsing, HMAC announce-ingest verification, announce-body validation, OTP code parsing, and release-feed/manifest parsing. Harnesses import the REAL production parsers (never reimplementations).
